name: HOC Drive to Client Bot
triggers: Google Drive OAuth (Google Drive account) watches folder HOC Clients: fileCreated, fileUpdated, folderCreated
Webhook GET+POST /webhook/hoc-drive-file — GET health/poll kick; POST file id/name/parents → Laravel poll --file
Schedule: every minute — POST /api/integrations/drive/poll (covers files inside company subfolders; n8n cannot watch nested folders)
action: POST {HOC_API_URL}/api/integrations/drive/poll with X-N8N-Secret. Folders send drive_folder_id only; files send drive_file_id.
laravel: ops:poll-drive --file={id} sends that Drive file to the client Telegram bot. Google changes.watch hits POST /api/integrations/drive/changed so an upload does not wait for the dashboard refresh button.
